categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Changes address selection inside addrman buckets in src/addrman.cpp and carries the P2P label.
categories.rationale: Fixes a severe sampling bias in addrman bucket selection that skews peer connection selection toward addresses following long runs of empty slots (up to 95.3% vs 4.7%). While not an urgent vulnerability, resolving this mathematical skew meaningfully improves peer diversity and eclipse resistance in sparse buckets as confirmed by reviewers.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Changes in test files are unit and fuzz tests pinning addrman behavior rather than changes to general test infrastructure or framework runners.
categories.rationale: Tests of a specific functional area belong to that area rather than the test infrastructure category.
